title: Supplies & Stuff
description: It fills in some gaps in the game and adds small stuff.
body:
![logo](https://github.com/m-station/Supplies-and-Stuff/blob/main/images/minecraft_title.png?raw=true)

**The Supplies & Stuff Mod adds new stuff or meaning to some unused features in the game.**

**Supplies & Stuff will also act as a bridge between the upcoming M-Station Mods. More content and connections between mods will be strengthened with the upcoming updates.**

**We have a wiki that explains the mod in more detail. If you'd like to learn more about the mod, head over to the [wiki](https://github.com/m-station/Supplies-and-Stuff/wiki).**
